name: pascal-lsp
description: Delphi / Object Pascal language support backed by the lint4d pascal-lsp server

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Workspace settings can select the server executable and arguments, while the server reads project files and source paths named by the workspace.

pascalLsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `pascal-lsp` executable. Supports `~` and `${workspaceFolder}`. Unset: the `PASCAL_LSP_BIN` environment variable, then `pascal-lsp` on `PATH`. Changing it restarts the server.

pascalLsp.serverArgs.markdownDescription: Extra arguments after `--stdio`. Changing them restarts the server.

pascalLsp.serverEnv.markdownDescription: Extra environment variables for the server process, for example `PASCAL_LSP_TRACE`. Changing them restarts the server.

pascalLsp.trace.server.description: Trace LSP messages to the Pascal LSP output channel.

pascalLsp.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the Pascal project status bar item.

pascalLsp.projectFile.markdownDescription: Delphi project (`.dproj`) to use, relative to the workspace. Unset = server default (nearest unambiguous project).

pascalLsp.buildConfig.markdownDescription: Build configuration, e.g. `Debug`. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.platform.markdownDescription: Target platform, e.g. `Win32`. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.sourcePaths.markdownDescription: Additional source directories (Delphi RTL/VCL, third-party libraries). Relative paths are relative to the workspace. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob patterns excluded from the workspace. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.compilerVersion.markdownDescription: Compiler version for conditionals, e.g. `24.0`. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.compilerOptions.markdownDescription: Compiler switch states for conditionals, e.g. `{"R": true, "Q": "off"}`. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.conditionalDefines.markdownDescription: Extra conditional defines. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.conditionalUndefines.markdownDescription: Conditional symbols known to be undefined. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.conditionalConstants.markdownDescription: Constants for `{$IF}` expressions, e.g. `{"BuildNumber": 42}`. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.maxFiles.markdownDescription: Workspace file limit. Unset = server default; values above the server's cap are clamped.

pascalLsp.maxFileBytes.markdownDescription: Per-file byte limit. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.maxTotalBytes.markdownDescription: Total workspace byte limit. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.maxCacheBytes.markdownDescription: Analysis memory budget in bytes. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.maxWorkspaceUnits.markdownDescription: Most units in one workspace snapshot. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.persistentCacheEnabled.markdownDescription: Enable the persistent analysis cache. Unset = server default (enabled).

pascalLsp.persistentCachePageBytes.markdownDescription: SQLite page cache bytes. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.persistentCacheScratchBytes.markdownDescription: Transient encode/decode buffer bytes. Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.persistentCacheWaitMs.markdownDescription: Longest lock wait per cache operation (ms). Unset = server default.

pascalLsp.persistentCacheDirectory.markdownDescription: Absolute cache directory (`~` is not expanded). Startup only: changing it restarts the server. Unset = platform directory.

pascalLsp.persistentCacheMaxNamespaces.markdownDescription: Builds whose cache entries are kept. Startup only: changing it restarts the server. Unset = server default.
